Policy Limits
Policy limit (Blanket Limit) shows the maximum amount 
covered for each peril. It is usually written at the start of the 
slip under “Sum Insured”.
Most perils share the same limit, but sometimes specific 
perils, regions, or locations have lower limits (sublimits) 
mentioned later in the slip.
If a limit is written as “annual aggregate” , it cannot be 
modelled in RMS RiskLink however model in Risk modeler.
Enter the policy limit in the PARTOF column in the ACC file.
